title: RC 移相电路：输出有效值不变，只改变相位
statement: U̇_s = 10∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s。两条支路并联在电源上：左支路 R_1 在上、C_1 在下，中点为 a；右支路 C_2 在上、R_2 在下，中点为 b。R_1 = R_2 = R = 200 Ω，C_1 = C_2 = C = 10 µF。
求 U_a、输出电压 u_ab 的有效值和初相，并说明调节 R 时 u_ab 如何变化。

questions.ask: a 点对地电压的有效值 U_a = ?
保持 C、ω 不变，R 从 0 增大到 ∞，u_ab 的变化是？
choices: 有效值始终等于 U_s，相位从 0° 逐渐变到 −180°
有效值从 0 增大到 U_s，相位不变
有效值始终为 U_s/2，相位从 0° 变到 −90°
choiceExplain: R = 0 时 U̇_a = U̇_s、U̇_b = 0，u_ab = u_s，并不是 0；|(1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC)| 恒为 1，随 R 变化的是相位。
比值 (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC) 含 ωRC，改变 R 时相位 −2arctan(ωRC) 会变，只是有效值不变。
这把单条 RC 支路的相位范围（U̇_a 从 0° 到 −90°）和从电源中点取输出的移相器（有效值 U_s/2）混在了一起；本电路 u_ab 是圆的直径，有效值恒为 U_s，相位可到 −180°。
questions.explain: U̇_ab/U̇_s = (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC)，模恒为 1，辐角 −2arctan(ωRC)：R = 0 时为 0°，ωRC = 1 时 −90°，R → ∞ 时趋于 −180°。这就是 RC 移相器。

hints: 两条支路都直接接在 U̇_s 上，各自是一个分压器。先算 X_C = 1/(ωC)。
U̇_a 取电容 C_1 上的分压，U̇_b 取电阻 R_2 上的分压；U̇_ab = U̇_a − U̇_b。
把 U̇_ab/U̇_s 化成 (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC)，注意分子、分母互为共轭。
solution: **4. 相量图。** U̇_a ⊥ U̇_b（−63.43° 与 26.57° 相差 90°），且 U̇_a + U̇_b = U̇_s，所以 a、b 两点都在以 U̇_s 为直径的圆上，U̇_ab 是这个圆的直径，长度恒为 U_s = **10 V**。
**5. 调节 R。** 改变 R 只让相位 −2arctan(ωRC) 在 0° ~ −180° 之间变化，有效值不变。

en.title: RC phase shifter: constant rms output, adjustable phase
statement: U_s = 10∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s. Two branches are connected across the source: in the left one R_1 is on top and C_1 below, with midpoint a; in the right one C_2 is on top and R_2 below, with midpoint b. R_1 = R_2 = R = 200 Ω, C_1 = C_2 = C = 10 µF.
Find U_a and the rms value and initial phase of the output u_ab, and explain how u_ab changes when R is adjusted.

questions.ask: rms voltage of node a to ground, U_a = ?

questions.explain: U_b = U_s·200/(200 − j100) = 10·j2/(1 + j2) = 8.944∠26.57° V. U_ab = U_s(1 − j2)/(1 + j2); numerator and denominator have equal magnitude, so U_ab = U_s = 10 V.

questions.ask: With C and ω fixed, R is increased from 0 to ∞. What happens to u_ab?
choices: Its rms value stays equal to U_s while its phase moves from 0° to −180°
Its rms value grows from 0 to U_s, the phase is unchanged
Neither the rms value nor the phase changes
Its rms value stays U_s/2 while the phase moves from 0° to −90°
choiceExplain: At R = 0, U̇_a = U̇_s and U̇_b = 0, so u_ab = u_s, not 0; |(1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC)| is always 1, and only the phase depends on R.
The ratio (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC) contains ωRC, so the phase −2arctan(ωRC) changes with R; only the rms value stays the same.

This mixes the phase range of one RC branch (U̇_a goes from 0° to −90°) with the shifter that takes its output from a centre-tapped source (rms U_s/2); here u_ab is a diameter of the circle, always U_s, and its phase reaches −180°.
questions.explain: U_ab/U_s = (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC) always has magnitude 1 and angle −2arctan(ωRC): 0° at R = 0, −90° at ωRC = 1, approaching −180° as R → ∞. This is the RC phase shifter.

hints: Both branches sit directly across U_s, each is a voltage divider. Start with X_C = 1/(ωC).
U_a is the share across C_1, U_b the share across R_2; U_ab = U_a − U_b.
Write U_ab/U_s as (1 − jωRC)/(1 + jωRC) and notice that numerator and denominator are conjugates.
solution: **4. Phasor diagram.** U_a ⊥ U_b (−63.43° and 26.57° differ by 90°) and U_a + U_b = U_s, so both points lie on the circle with U_s as diameter, and U_ab is also a diameter of that circle: its length is always U_s = **10 V**.
**5. Adjusting R.** Changing R only moves the phase −2arctan(ωRC) between 0° and −180°; the rms value stays the same.
